title: Over-The-Air Extreme Learning Machines with Nonlinear Stacked Intelligent Metasurfaces
abstract: arXiv:2608.27137v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The recently envisioned goal-oriented communications paradigm requires machine learning inference to be performed directly on wirelessly transferred data. This paper presents an eXtremely Large (XL) Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) system that operates as an Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) to execute Over-The-Air (OTA) binary classification. To reduce hardware complexity, the receiver is equipped with cascaded metasurfaces terminating in a single radio-frequency chain. A front metasurface layer applies a fixed nonlinear response to the incoming signal, acting as the ELM's activation function. Subsequent tunable linear metasurface layers physically approximate the trained network weights directly in the wave domain. Numerical evaluations across diverse datasets showcase that our XL MIMO architecture achieves classification accuracy comparable to idealized digital models, thereby proving the viability of low-complexity, wave-domain O

translated_title: 基于非线性堆叠智能超表面的空中极限学习机
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27137v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：最近提出的目标导向通信范式要求直接在无线传输数据上执行机器学习推理。本文提出了一种超大规模多输入多输出系统，该系统作为极限学习机运行以执行空中二分类任务。为降低硬件复杂度，接收器配备了级联超表面，并终止于单个射频链。前超表面层对输入信号施加固定的非线性响应，充当ELM的激活函数。随后的可调线性超表面层直接在波域中物理近似训练好的网络权重。跨多种数据集的数值评估表明，我们的超大规模MIMO架构实现了与理想化数字模型相当的分类精度，从而证明了低复杂度、波域空中计算的可行性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种利用超大规模MIMO和级联超表面实现空中二分类的极限学习机架构，通过非线性激活和可调线性层直接在波域中执行推理，在降低硬件复杂度的同时达到与数字模型相当的精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an extreme learning machine architecture using extremely large MIMO and cascaded metasurfaces for over-the-air binary classification, achieving accuracy comparable to digital models while reducing hardware complexity via wave-domain inference.
